endorsements.name: Hoang Nguyen
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-27911
endorsements.description: Mautic versions before 3.3.4/4.0.0 are vulnerable to an inline JS XSS attack through the contact's first or last name and triggered when viewing a contact's details page then clicking on the action drop down and hovering over the Campaigns button. Contact first and last name can be populated from different sources such as UI, API, 3rd party syncing, forms, etc.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.3)

endorsements.name: Hoang Nguyen
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-27912
endorsements.description: Mautic versions before 3.3.4/4.0.0 are vulnerable to an inline JS XSS attack when viewing Mautic assets by utilizing inline JS in the title and adding a broken image URL as a remote asset. This can only be leveraged by an authenticated user with permission to create or edit assets.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.1)
